info.title: Resident Directory Backend API
info.description:
FastAPI backend for resident directory management.

Auth: obtain a JWT via POST /auth/login, then call protected endpoints with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Roles:
- admin: full access
- viewer: read-only

post.summary: Login (basic auth) and receive a JWT
post.description: Authenticates a user by email/password and returns a JWT access token.

get.summary: List residents with search and filters
get.description: Supports q (search), building/floor/unit filters, is_active, and pagination.

post.description: Uploads a photo for a resident and sets photo_url. RBAC: admin.

get.description: Exports residents (optionally filtered) as CSV. RBAC: admin.

post.description: CSV columns: full_name, unit, building, floor, phone, email, notes, is_active. If id provided, updates that resident.

get.description: RBAC: viewer/admin. Returns {items, total, limit, offset}.
